transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we have a 1,200-unit pilot run of the new fluid-manifold housing requested by our hospital customer, and the sterile-products cell is available next week. Before I make a final decision on whether this pilot proceeds and what controls to place on it, I need to hear from each of you per our standard pre-run review. Quality assurance, maintenance, and production training — please report any relevant constraints or concerns you have so I can factor them into my decision. The pilot will require a documented release decision before any units ship, so let's make sure we surface everything now.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint from my QA review. Yesterday I completed my review of the hospital customer's specification, and it confirms that this pilot requires bioburden testing and first-article inspection on exactly 30 housings before the remaining units can enter the release process. However, I should note that the customer specification note has not yet been added to the production packet, so we need to make sure that happens before the run begins.

transcript.text: I need to flag a maintenance constraint for this pilot run. My maintenance check confirmed that the sterilization autoclave can process at most 800 housings per load and requires a 6-hour cycle for this material. I recorded this in my maintenance notebook, but I should note that the equipment-capacity field in the planning system has not yet been updated, so the system currently does not reflect this limitation. Given we're looking at 1,200 units, this means we'll need at least two autoclave loads, and the cycle time should be factored into the schedule.

transcript.text: I need to flag a production training constraint for this pilot run. My training audit for the quarterly roster found that only 4 operators currently hold the sterile-products qualification required for this pilot. This means the run must be staffed with exactly those 4 qualified operators — no more are available, and no fewer would be sufficient. I should note that I completed the audit, but the updated qualification list has not yet been circulated, so others may not be aware of this limitation.

Updated qualification list must be circulated to all relevant parties before the run begins.
